title: SirioCraft Create
description: A Create-focused civilisation SMP pack built around factories, trains, airships, towns, claims, trade, and community infrastructure.
body:
# SirioCraft Create

SirioCraft Create is a beta Create-focused civilisation SMP modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge.

The pack is built around factories, trains, airships, towns, claims, trade routes, player communities, food production, and public infrastructure. It starts with Create as the core technology system, then expands into a community server experience with Aeronautics, Create addons, Farmer’s Delight, Xaero maps, Open Parties and Claims, and quality-of-life tools.

## Current Status

This pack is currently in beta.

Expect balance changes, config changes, mod changes, and possible world resets while the server is being tested.

## Main Features

- Create-based automation and engineering
- Airships and vehicles through Create Aeronautics
- Trains, factories, machinery, and industrial builds
- Land claims and player groups
- Food production and community trade through Farmer’s Delight
- Maps, waypoints, JEI recipes, Jade tooltips, and performance improvements
- Server-focused civilisation gameplay: towns, factories, railways, shops, and infrastructure

## Server

This pack is designed for the SirioCraft Create server.

The server should appear automatically in the multiplayer menu after launching the pack.

## Beta Warning

This is not the final Season 1 build. The purpose of this beta is to test stability, balance, server performance, claims, vehicles, Create systems, and multiplayer usability.
